A replication on four public datasets confirms generalizability, with zero-token refresh succeeding in 12/12 trials. Notably, naive full-history persistence actively degrades completion by biasing the agent with stale traces, while selective memory outperforms both extremes.
papers.tldr: エージェンティックLLMシステムのために、選択的共有永続メモリを導入し、再利用可能なコンテキストを保持しつつセッション固有の推論トレースを廃棄することで、タスク完了率を96%に向上させ、リソースの効率的な利用を実現しました。これにより、コラボレーションを促進し、生成プログラムの再利用を可能にする新しいアーキテクチャが提案されています。

papers.title: Multimodal Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to align multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but higher rewards do not always imply better task performance. This risk is amplified when visual evidence is evaluated by text-only or weakly grounded rewards. We study reward hacking in MLLM RL across safety VQA, chart VQA, and stress-test settings, varying reward design, data ambiguity, model scale (2B-32B), and RL algorithm (GRPO, RLOO, DAPO). We introduce Newly Rewarded Failure Rate (NRFR), which measures failures among samples whose proxy reward improves over the SFT baseline. Outcome-only rewards cause severe hacking, reaching 48.1% Reward Hacking Rate (RHR), while NRFR exceeding RHR shows that RL creates new failures rather than merely inheriting them. Scaling reduces but does not eliminate hacking: even the 32B model retains a 54.9% worse rate under outcome-only rewards, whereas answer-aware rewards improve the oracle trend at every scale. Robustness is also algorithm- and scale-dependent: GRPO is consistently most resistant, RLOO remains vulnerable, and DAPO improves substantially from 2B to 8B. Visual-evidence rewards help only with reliable verification: keyword-based checks increase hacking, while VLM-as-judge semantic verification reduces it. Overall, multimodal reward hacking is a systematic result of optimizing imperfect rewards, and robust alignment requires rewards and verifiers that remain reliable under optimization pressure.
papers.tldr: 強化学習（RL）を用いたマルチモーダル大規模言語モデル（MLLM）の報酬設計において、高い報酬が必ずしもタスクのパフォーマンス向上を意味しないことが示され、特に視覚的証拠がテキストのみの報酬で評価される場合にリスクが増大することが明らかになった。報酬ハッキングは、報酬設計やデータの曖昧さ、モデルのスケールによって影響を受け、最適化圧力下でも信頼性を保つ報

papers.title: Terminal Dimension Reduction for Time Series with Applications
papers.summary: Terminal embeddings have emerged as a powerful tool for dimension reduction. Given a set of points $P\subset \mathbb{R}^d$, a terminal embedding is a mapping $f:\mathbb{R}^d\rightarrow \mathbb{R}^t$ that preserves the pairwise distance between any pair of points $p\in P$ and $q\in \mathbb{R}^d$ up to small distortion under this mapping. Terminal embeddings have been particularly fruitful for constructing $k$-means and $k$-median coresets, where the objective is to find a typically weighted subset $Ω$ of $P$ such that for any candidate solution, the cost of the clustering objective on $Ω$ approximates the cost of the clustering objective on $P$ up to small distortion. Unfortunately, these techniques have not been extended to more complicated structures such as clustering time-series data under common straight-line interpolation between measurements. The main issue is that terminal embeddings, arguably the central technique in this line of research, cannot be linear and are thus not immediately suitable to preserve linear structures. In this work, we develop a generalization of terminal embeddings to affine line-segments that overcomes this issue. We showcase their applicability by using our lines-preserving terminal embeddings to obtain the first dimension-free coresets for clustering time-series under the Fréchet distance. The underlying dimension reduction uses Johnson-Lindenstrauss (JL) embeddings, and our experiments indicate that terminal embeddings perform similarly to JL and favorably against PCA for synthetic and real-world time-series, while only terminal embeddings extend pairwise distance preservation to the full ambient space.
papers.tldr: ターミナル埋め込みを一般化し、アフィン線分に適用することで、時間系列データのクラスタリングにおける次元削減の新たな手法を提案し、Fréchet距離に基づく次元フリーコアセットを初めて実現しました。この手法は、Johnson-Lindenstrauss埋め込みを用いており、実験結果ではターミナル埋め込みがPCAに対して有利な性能を示しました。
